text: You know, I think about where we are today. We're no longer waiting for the intelligence revolution to begin. We're living through it. Models like GPT-6 Astra,  GPT-5.6 Saul, Gemini 3.5, and Grok 4.6  can reason across complex problems, write and debug software, analyze documents and images, conduct research, and carry out sophisticated  workflows using digital tools. The real breakthrough is no longer just the model. It's the rise of  AI agents, systems that can plan, investigate, compare evidence, use tools, and  coordinate with other specialized agents to complete complex tasks. This may be the most  consequential technological transformation of our lifetime. But greater intelligence does not

Automatically  produce better decisions. Financial markets remain noisy, uncertain, and deeply human AI companies are evolving rapidly. Valuations can move faster than fundamentals, and yesterday's  market leader can quickly become tomorrow's cautionary tale. In this new landscape, investors need tools  designed specifically for the intelligence revolution. In the world of Sherlock Holmes, one character possessed analytical powers that may have exceeded those of the famous detective  himself. His elder brother, Mycroft. Today, we've created a namesake worthy of that legacy. >>  >> Introducing Mycroft, the open-source multi-agent framework that uses AI to analyze investments in the AI economy. While others see an  overwhelming stream of announcements, earnings

Reports, benchmarks, regulations, and market speculation, Mycroft searches for meaningful patterns. Its research agents generate comprehensive reports  on companies across the AI ecosystem. From semiconductor manufacturers and cloud platforms to foundation model developers, enterprise applications, robotics,  cybersecurity, data centers, and energy infrastructure. But Mycroft doesn't stop at generating reports. Verification agents  independently examine important claims, compare multiple sources, identify conflicting evidence, and distinguish  established facts from assumptions and speculation. Comparative analysis agents evaluate  companies within clearly defined sub sectors. They examine competitive advantages, financial  performance, technical capabilities, strategic partnerships, market positioning, potential vulnerabilities  and risks. Portfolio agents translate that research into disciplined investment strategies.

Diversification  agents monitor exposure across companies, industries, technologies, and economic scenarios. Risk management  agents evaluate concentration, volatility, liquidity, draw downs, and position limits before dilettantism turns into excessive risk. Mycroft's conversational  advisors speak your language. Whether you're an experienced investor, a researcher, or just beginning to  explore the AI economy, they adapt to your level of knowledge and translate complex financial and technical concepts into  clear, accessible guidance. Meanwhile, intelligence agents continuously monitor market news, regulatory developments, company disclosures, technical research, competitive  announcements, and shifts in public sentiment. At the heart of it all, System Mycroft's orchestration layer. The system that coordinates these  specialized agents, records the

Evidence, challenges the conclusions, and combines their work into an intelligence  greater than the sum of its parts. Mycroft does not predict the future with certainty. It does something more valuable.  It helps you investigate possibilities, question assumptions, understand uncertainty, and make more informed  decisions. Mycroft doesn't replace human judgment. It amplifies it. It brings sophisticated research and analytical capabilities  to individual investors while leaving accountability and final decisions where they belong, in human hands.  Mycroft, using AI to understand investing >>  >> the AI economy. An open source framework for transparent, evidence-driven investment research. Mycroft, not just  code, but a spirit reborn.
A sonnet in silicon. A new market  dawn.
